tasks.label: run-model-manager-service
tasks.command: $healthUrl='http://127.0.0.1:8002/health'; try { Invoke-RestMethod -Uri $healthUrl -TimeoutSec 2 | Out-Null; Write-Host 'Model Manager already running on 127.0.0.1:8002'; exit 0 } catch {}; Set-Location services/model-manager; if (Test-Path '../../.venv/Scripts/python.exe') { ../../.venv/Scripts/python.exe -m uvicorn main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8002 } else { c:/python314/python.exe -m uvicorn main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8002 }
